title: 社会・集団・家族心理学
subtitle: Social, Group and Family Psychology
educationalGoal: Students will learn about: (1) social impacts on self and social cognition. (2) dynamics of families, groups, and culture. (3) methodology of studying social psychology.
advice: We will cover the following topics: 1. Methodology of studying social psychology 2. Interpersonal cognition 3. Social cognition and social inference 4. Attitudes and persuasion 5. Conformity, social loafing, and social dilemma 6. Family relationships 7. Social psychology in different regions and cultures
requiredKnowledge: Completion of the “Elements of Psychology” and “Method of Psychological Research” courses is recommended.

activityGoals.body: Ability to understand and explain the process of social cognition.
Ability to understand and explain the process of changing attitudes.
Ability to understand and explain the relationships between members in a family or group.

 CLIP学習プロセスについて
 一般に、授業あるいは課外での学習では:「知識などを取り込む」→「知識などをいろいろな角度から、場合によってはチーム活動として、考え、推論し、創造する」→「修得した内容を表現、発表、伝達する」→「総合的に評価を受ける、GoodWork!」:のようなプロセス(一部あるいは全体)を繰り返し行いながら、応用力のある知識やスキルを身につけていくことが重要です。このような学習プロセスを大事に行動してください。
